Title: JSONViewer
Description: A self-contained web component Add-On for FileMaker that displays structured JSON data. Expand objects individually or all at once by holding the Option key. Supports light and dark mode, custom background colors, and adjustable font size in points. Compatible with FileMaker 22+.
Features: Display and explore JSON arrays and objects
Expand individual or all objects by holding the Option key
Supports light and dark mode with customizable background color
Self-contained and easy to integrate web component
